name: Role Based Auth
description: Document with creator-as-admin RBAC enforced inside the reducer

modules.name: access
modules.description: Authorization operations: bootstrap, role changes, and role-gated domain actions.

operations.name: BOOTSTRAP
operations.description: First caller becomes creator and first admin. Can only be called once.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: Caller is not authenticated (missing signer context)

errors.name: AlreadyBootstrapped
errors.description: The document has already been bootstrapped

operations.name: GRANT_ADMIN
operations.description: Promote an address to admin. Caller must be an admin.

operations.name: REVOKE_ADMIN
operations.description: Remove an address from admins. Cannot revoke the creator or the last admin.

operations.name: ADD_MEMBER
operations.description: Add an address as a member. Caller must be an admin.

errors.name: AddressAlreadyAdmin
errors.description: Cannot add an admin as a member; revoke admin first

operations.name: REMOVE_MEMBER
operations.description: Remove an address from members. Caller must be an admin.

operations.name: WRITE_NOTE
operations.description: Append a note. Caller must be an admin or member. id and createdAt come from input (reducers must be deterministic).

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: Caller is not authenticated or has no role on this document
